newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FAI and Alpic to seek India licence.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FAI and Alpic to seek India licence.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd said on Wednesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Alpic Finance Ltd in the first stage of a joint venture that would eventually seek an insurance licence in India.

"The Indian general insurance market is currently controlled by four government-owned companies, although it is hoped that the market will be opened up in 1997," FAI chairman John Landerer told the company's annual meeting.
FAI said Alpic was the third largest non-banking financial services group in India.
"We believe considerable opportunities for profitable growth still exist within the ASEAN region and we will continue to expand our involvement in the region," Landerer said.
FAI has recently established a representative office in Bangkok and obtained licences in Guam and the Philippines.
